learning_outcomes.text: Provide tools and methods for the metrological analysis, prototyping, and testing of data acquisition systems.

Prototyping and testing of conditioning circuits and data acquisition systems in several application fields, from the biomedical up to distributed measurement systems based on the Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm.

syllabus_topics: Electronic circuits for analog signal processing
Standard for the metrological characterization of A/D converters
Microcontrollers for the implementation of data acquisition systems
Arbitrary waveform generators based on D/A converters
Standard for the metrological characterization of D/A converters
Conditioning circuits for the acquisition of biopotential signal
Electronic instrumentation for the acquisition of electromyogram (EMG) signals
Electronic instrumentation for the acquisition of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals
Electronic instrumentation for the acquisition of electroencephalogram (EEG) signals
General architecture of an IoT system
Digital communication interfaces for smart transducers
Data acquisition systems: design, implementation, and testing of a data acquisition system
Biomedical instrumentation: design, implementation, and testing of an electrocardiograph
Measurement systems based on the Internet of Things (IoT) paradigm: design, implementation, and testing of a distributed measurement system
assessment_rules: The final exam is oral and includes a discussion on the laboratory activities and the verification of the theoretical aspects. The evaluation will be attributed for 1/2 on the basis of the discussion regarding the laboratory activities and for 1/2 on the basis of the clarity and completeness in the exposition of the theoretical topics.
